test_title: RRB ALP CBT-II (Mechanic Diesel) Official Paper (Held On: 06 May, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Which of the following is not the correct function of the front axle?

options.text: It transmits the vehicle's torque to the front wheels through springs.
It absorbs the torque applied on the vehicle due to braking.
It supports the weight of the front part of the vehicle.
An axle is a central shaft for a rotating wheel or gear.

solution:
The correct answer is __It transmits the vehicle's torque to the front wheels through springs.__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Front axle__ is a crucial part of vehicle design.
 
• The front axle serves multiple functions including supporting the weight of the front of the vehicle.
 
• It absorbs torque applied to the vehicle due to braking.
 
• An axle is a central shaft used for rotating wheels or gears.
 
• However, the transmission of vehicle torque to front wheels through springs is not a function of the front axle.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Types of Axles:**

 
 
• Axles can be classified into front axles, rear axles, and stub axles.
 
• Front axles are designed to carry the weight of the vehicle's front and facilitate steering.
 
 
 
• **Rear Axle:**
 
 
• Rear axles transmit power from the engine to the wheels.
 
• They are often split into two halves connected by a differential.
 
 
 
• **Stub Axle:**
 
 
• Stub axles are used in vehicles with independent suspension.
 
• They are connected to the front wheels and allow for steering.
